scope: R10 private decoder CDF adaptation-count reset; no CDF representation or public method-set change

native_reference.source: src/cdf.c:3916 onward dav1d_cdf_thread_update; copy context then clear known counter slots

protocol.baseline_binary_provenance: Built from clean merged b9e260f4 before the R10 edits, matching tree 3b988381227b930c4c2c2d5555c836a583580f25. Same Go toolchain and public full-clip harness as candidate.
protocol.protocol: One short paired screen of private trusted CDF counter reset. Warm public Reset+DecodeNext, workers=1. Target p360_intra_q32 must save >=0.5% by paired geometric mean and win >=2/3 pairs; p720_inter_q32 affected comparison must regress <=1%. Both clips use the changed reset: the untimed oracle counted 48 trusted intra resets and 49 trusted/3 generic inter resets. All actual rows must report 0 allocs/op; B/op is separately retained and reported without a zero-byte gate, since the prior unchanged harness reported occasional 2 B/op at 0 allocs/op. Three alternating pairs, 12 processes and exactly 12 benchmark rows, all retained. Every slash component is independently anchored. No retry, resampling, postselection or native-gap claim.

environment.coordinated_agent_cpu_work: paused for screen; other host activity not controlled
